topic: Ivan Pavlov (1903-1927) Saint Petersburg Metronome Salivary Conditioning, Soundproof Trench Laboratory, Krestovnikov 374 Backward-Order Trials, and Brainstem Reflex Wiring (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Krestovnikov's 374 failed backward-order bell pairings versus 1-trial forward buzzer conditioning and Rescorla's 1988 contingency discovery proving brains wire predictive cues rather than mere temporal contiguity.
